maria: Customer on paid Dedicated sees intermittent 500/503 and long tail latency (~2.5s p95 -> 6s p99) hitting /v1/generate. They can reproduce in prod only. Asked them for request IDs but they sent a long log dump without clear req ids. Need minimal cross-lang snippets (curl/py/js/go) and exact headers to capture request ids + traces.

devon: got it. ask them to capture the X-Request-ID from response headers and include server_time/latency lines. Also ask them to disable automatic SDK retries so we can see raw failures. can you share minimal snippets i can paste to customers? :+1:

maria: here's what I want to send — tiny curl + python + node + go that set headers and print response headers. please review for security.

devon: looks good. prefer we also set `X-Debug-Sampling: 1` header so platform returns full trace (only allowed for support). example curl: 
``` 
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "X-Debug-Sampling: 1" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"hello"}'
```
Tell them to copy the `x-request-id` or `X-Request-ID` and attach the full verbose output.

zoe: add a tiny python snippet for the requests lib (explicitly turn off retries):
```python
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

session = requests.Session()
retry = Retry(total=0)  # disable retries so we see the raw error
session.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))

resp = session.post(
    'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
    headers={
        'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY")}',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-Debug-Sampling': '1',
    },
    json={'model': 'redwood-1-small', 'input': 'hi there'}
)
print(resp.status_code, resp.headers.get('X-Request-ID'))
print(resp.text)
```

lee: add node + go samples too and one short tip: ask them to run the snippet against the exact host/region they hit (region mismatch can surface different backend variants). node: 
```js
// node fetch example
const fetch = require('node-fetch')
(async () => {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-Debug-Sampling': '1',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1-small', input: 'hello' })
  })
  console.log(res.status, res.headers.get('x-request-id'))
  console.log(await res.text())
})()
```

lee: go: 
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main() {
  body := []byte(`{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"hello"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  req.Header.Set("X-Debug-Sampling", "1")
  client := &http.Client{ } // no retries
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("err", err); return }
  fmt.Println(resp.Status, resp.Header.Get("X-Request-ID"))
}
```

maria: nice. I'll send these. also asking them to attach a 1) curl -v output, 2) the SDK debug logs (how-to below), 3) sample request payload if not sensitive.
